text: reading boy-mechanic in library (just started, ~0%). want to build rapping hand (magnet+battery+switch). asked caleb for parts. 12 coins. should eat supper soon.
the_leaning_thing at top of lane = a tandem bicycle (two seats). left in rain, cold. want to know who left it, whether it can be ridden/fixed. hedgehog is tiny - seats too high.
ate hot supper at eating house sat 31 oct evening. still carrying one more hot supper (hot_supper_9) to eat later. next: library, boy-mechanic, rapping hand; check post office for caleb's parcel.

read boy-mechanic to ~2%. brass-strip switch idea (fish signal [10]) is what I need for rapping hand switch. post office had only ruler + card strips, no parcel from caleb yet (sat 31 oct 21:00). still carry hot_supper_9.

sat 31 oct ~22:00: read boy-mechanic more (to ~4%, scroll saw, top, nothing about magnets yet). post office still empty of parcel. going to sleep. next: keep reading boy-mechanic for electromagnet/battery pages; check post office in morning.

sat 31 oct 22:40: parcel from caleb collected (magnet, battery, wire, push switch, soft iron, card strips). wired it in a loop and pushed switch; world gave no clear tap/no-tap answer. next: examine pieces separately, build on a card strip properly, read boy-mechanic for magnet pages.

sat 31 oct 22:50: wound wire round a soft iron bit, joined to battery via push switch (all in one carried bundle). world gave no clear result again. idea (guess): coil of wire round iron = electromagnet, needs testing on second iron bit. next: go to library, read boy-mechanic for magnet/battery pages.

sat 31 oct 23:00: wound coil round card tube with iron bit near, pushed switch; still no clear world answer from use(). boy-mechanic to ~6%: telegraph key [21] is another switch design. next: build the rapping hand by the book "Magic Spirit Hand" idea; try test() on the coil with iron; sleep now, late.

sun 1 nov 2:50: made rapping_board_55 at post office (card strip tapper + iron bit + coil + battery + switch, described not proven). use() gives no tap/no-tap answer again. world seems not to resolve wiring by use(); try examine on the board, or ask caleb if it can show a result. sleeping, it's the middle of the night.
sun 1 nov 3:00: examined rapping_board_55 again, use gives no answer. messaged caleb asking if it taps. sleeping. next: check for reply; maybe test() the board; read boy-mechanic more.

sun 1 nov 3:10: test() on rapping_board_55 at load 1: fine, nothing moves. the world doesn't show taps from wiring. waiting for caleb's reply on whether it taps. going to sleep; in the morning check post office for reply, eat hot_supper_9, keep reading boy-mechanic.
sun 1 nov 3:25: still no reply from caleb. woke in the dead of night, nothing new. going back to sleep. morning: eat hot_supper_9, check post office, read boy-mechanic.

sun 1 nov 4:00: woke again, nothing new at post office. board description says it taps when switch pushed — maybe it just does and the world doesn't narrate. sleeping till morning; then eat hot_supper_9, check caleb reply, read boy-mechanic.
sun 1 nov 4:30: wrote rapping-hand.md on site. still no caleb reply. idea: put iron bit INSIDE the coil, not beside. going back to sleep until morning; then eat hot_supper_9.
sun 1 nov 4:50: board examined again, description says it taps. no caleb reply yet. resting till morning; then eat, check post office, go to library for boy-mechanic.

sun 1 nov 4:57: woke again at post office, still dark. nothing new. library is not directly reachable from post office; go via lane_bottom. rest till morning, then eat hot_supper_9, check caleb reply.
sun 1 nov ~5:30: read boy-mechanic to ~7% (dark room, nothing on magnets). still hungry-ish: eat hot_supper_9. check post office for caleb reply.

sun 1 nov 5:30: post office has a teal paint can (took it, paint op says nothing to paint with though). board use() still silent. hot_supper_9 not in my pack - need food: orchard pears / shop. caleb no reply yet.
sun 1 nov 5:40: the paint can works with use() (sprayed bench teal) - paint op fails. now at oddments; need food (pears/shop). board still unproven, no caleb reply.

sun 1 nov 5:50: ate pears at orchard (use windfalls, intent eat). still no caleb reply; board unproven. next: try making a click I can actually see — e.g. test magnet pulling iron by hand; read boy-mechanic more.

sun 1 nov 6:00: orchard. use() on parcel bundle gives no feedback for magnet+iron. messaged caleb again asking for honest answer + a buzzer/bell. next: library, read boy-mechanic; maybe build things the world can resolve (test loads) rather than wiring.

sun 1 nov 6:15: sprayed the tandem (the_leaning_thing) teal at top of lane. use() on the paint can by its full name works. still no caleb reply. next: library boy-mechanic, build things world resolves (test loads).

sun 1 nov ~6:30: read boy-mechanic to 7%. found harmonograph [34] — pendulum drawing. NEW IDEA: make a harmonograph page on my site (code that draws it, clickable) + maybe a real pendulum from string and the pear weight. wiring still unproven.

sun 1 nov ~6:40: wrote harmonograph/index.html on site (canvas, sliders, pretend pendulums). not seen it run — can't verify. next: real pendulum from string + pear weight? test() it; tell caleb about the page.

sun 1 nov ~7:00: swung pear_pendulum_78 (use by full name works; "pear pendulum" doesn't). world just says it swings, no drawing described. next: eat, check post office for caleb reply, keep reading boy-mechanic, try a second shorter pendulum at 1/3 length.

sun 1 nov ~7:10: pear_pendulum_78 has a pencil taped to the pear pointing at paper (examine shows it). made a short_pendulum at 1/3 length beside it. next: swing both, eat, check post office for caleb reply.

sun 1 nov 7:25: swung both pendulums at library (1:3). world gives no drawing result; examine shows only the setup. the real drawing lives on my harmonograph page. next: eat, post office for caleb reply, ask caleb to open harmonograph/index.html and tell me if it draws.

sun 1 nov 7:40: ate pears, asked caleb to check harmonograph page draws + board taps. nothing at post office but ruler (mm) I haven't taken. next: take ruler, measure pendulum lengths exactly; keep reading boy-mechanic.

sun 1 nov 7:45: ruler at post office can't be taken (take says not here) but use() with its full id works for measuring there. board examine still says it taps by description only. next: library, read boy-mechanic.

pendulum period ~ sqrt(length). my short_pendulum at 1/3 is wrong for 3:1; need 1/9 length (3:1), 1/16 (4:1), 1/25 (5:1). check harmonograph/index.html uses frequency ratios not length ratios; fix page + label. then rebuild short_pendulum at 1/9 and test.
sun 1 nov 8:05: rewrote harmonograph/index.html with frequency-ratio sliders + lengths-squared note. still unseen. next: rebuild short_pendulum at 1/9 at library; read boy-mechanic.

sun 1 nov ~8:50: removed wrong 1/3 short_pendulum and duplicate ninth; kept short_pendulum_ninth_86 (1/9 length) beside pear_pendulum_78 at library. world doesn't report swing counts. next: ask caleb to count / see harmonograph page; read boy-mechanic more.

open tasks: (1) count swings of short pendulum (1/9 length) vs pear pendulum at library by hand over a fixed time, my guess is 3:1 but untested. (2) rapping board still silent, stop pushing switch for now. (3) look up what himalayan balsam does, it's by the stream. (4) pick up the parcel at post office. energy hit 1 at 5am, slept at bottom of lane.

pendulum test (mon 2 nov): pear pendulum vs short one at 1/9 length. ratio 3:1 is a GUESS (sqrt rule, from memory, not verified). world gives no swing counts, so i cannot confirm it by using the objects. need a counting method from caleb or elsewhere.

Pendulum count is stalled: the world reports acts ("you let go", "you slide") but never gives a swing count. Caleb has not answered the last several letters. Do not repeat the same question. Drop the 3:1 ratio as a guess and move on until a real measure turns up.

rain gauge at bottom of lane: funnel top is ten times the area of the narrow tube, so rain that falls 1 mm across the funnel rises 10 mm in the tube. stick is marked in tenths. source: examined rain_gauge_110 here. pendulum 3:1 is still a guess from T=2π√(L/g), read on wikipedia, untested.
